overview.description: The Aura AI Photonics ETF (PHOX) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the VettaFi AI Photonics index. The fund tracks an index of 25 optical and photonic companies engaged in the generation, transmission, and processing of data using light-based signaling for AI computing. The fund selects and weights companies by their engagement ranking and market capitalization. PHOX was launched on Aug 10, 2026 and is issued by Aura.
